I was born and raised in Switzerland but my family was always excluded from participation (since my grandma immigrated from Austria), so I grew up very poor. Am 34 now and still fiat-poor but "seasoned". Few months ago I bought my first ETH and started to dive into crypto. Found out that crypto is the future and I want to help growing and spreading this bright future for all of us. Take care everyone. 👋 hello! super new to the community, but I'm the newest member of the Prysm team. I'll be helping them on their frontend and UX
